race.comment: SUNSETS (1) is putting together some solid results of late. Finished third at Sandown-Lakeside two starts back then got the job done by a head last time out over 2100m at Sandown-Lakeside. Suited this level and will take beating again. ALL SO CLEAR (3) is very consistent, a winner here three back followed up by two minor placings. Is 2/2 here and will be very hard to hold out. HOT TOO GO (8) has been solid his past couple in Adelaide and comes here off a freshen. First go synthetic but has the figures to challenge, respecting. WOLFOFFITROYSTREET (12) accounted for a maiden field over 2200m at Ballarat Synthetic last start, scoring by a head. Might be able to go on with it now.
